topic: POINTCLOUD DXF writer version transaction matrix

generatedFields: class version, origin, saved filename, two source file names and count
extents, point count, UCS name, origin and axes
AC1027+ intensity scheme and four intensity-range values in the version-loss probe
profile.definitionAndReactorHandles: null in the matrix profile; no external graph claim

validation.rollback: Every injected allocation failure preserves the prior destination and caller POINTCLOUD.
validation.retry: Same-codec retry after each injected failure reproduces the clean reference bytes.
validation.readback: Fresh typed readback checks the generated baseline fields in each version and encoding; a separate late-state probe checks the AC1027+ intensity fields.
versionBoundaries: AC1018 ASCII and Binary refusal for the unsupported base POINTCLOUD entity preserves destination and caller state, then retries at AC1021.
AC1024 ASCII and Binary refusal of nondefault AC1027+ intensity fields preserves destination and caller state, then retries at AC1027.

proves: Generated POINTCLOUD writer transaction behavior for AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 in ASCII and Binary.
The minimum supported target refusal and the selected AC1027+ intensity-field loss guard.
doesNotProve: Producer prevalence or independent consumer semantics.
Definition/reactor handle graph closure or non-null reference transport.
POINTCLOUD clipping, intensity display, or broader DWG support.
